exposure: Postpartum blood loss > 1000 ml vs. ≤ 1000 ml
cohort: 246 patients with confirmed pernicious placenta previa
finding: Researchers developed and validated a nomogram for predicting postpartum hemorrhage in patients with pernicious placenta previa, which showed better accuracy than using ultrasonic scores alone.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight included in the nomogram
